items.title: 專案成果頁改版：每個專案附 30 秒動畫介紹
items.body: 專案成果頁改為影片卡片，點開即可觀看各專案的 30 秒動畫導覽，後續將陸續加入更多專案。
items.title_en: Projects page redesign: every project now has a 30-second animated intro
items.body_en: The projects page now uses video cards. Click any card to watch a 30-second animated tour of the project; more projects will be added over time.
